# Conformance vectors of version 1 of the NVXL listener announcement, which nvx-ingress sends to
# the gateway of the portable network profile, and which OpenVMM's net_backend_resources::ingress
# parses. README.md describes the line format and the rules that the vectors follow.
#
# ANNOUNCEMENT|NAME|BYTES|OMITTED|LISTENERS
#   OMITTED is 1 when the announcement omits listeners beyond the 64 that it carries, and 0
#   otherwise. LISTENERS is a list of listeners in increasing order of protocol and port, each
#   PROTOCOL|FAMILIES|PORT, with PROTOCOL TCP or UDP and FAMILIES IPV4, IPV6, or BOTH.

# No listener.
ANNOUNCEMENT|NONE|4e56584c01000000|0|0
# A UDP listener reachable over IPv4.
ANNOUNCEMENT|UDP|4e56584c0100000111011c21|0|1|UDP|IPV4|7201
# A TCP listener reachable over both families.
ANNOUNCEMENT|DUAL_STACK|4e56584c0100000106031f90|0|1|TCP|BOTH|8080
# Two TCP listeners, one reachable over IPv4 and the other over IPv6.
ANNOUNCEMENT|TWO_LISTENERS|4e56584c0100000206011f90060220fb|0|2|TCP|IPV4|8080|TCP|IPV6|8443
# The 64 lowest of more TCP listeners, reachable over IPv4, and the flag that marks the omitted
# ones.
ANNOUNCEMENT|OMITTED_LISTENERS||1|64|TCP|IPV4|1|TCP|IPV4|2|TCP|IPV4|3|TCP|IPV4|4|TCP|IPV4|5|TCP|IPV4|6|TCP|IPV4|7|TCP|IPV4|8|TCP|IPV4|9|TCP|IPV4|10|TCP|IPV4|11|TCP|IPV4|12|TCP|IPV4|13|TCP|IPV4|14|TCP|IPV4|15|TCP|IPV4|16|TCP|IPV4|17|TCP|IPV4|18|TCP|IPV4|19|TCP|IPV4|20|TCP|IPV4|21|TCP|IPV4|22|TCP|IPV4|23|TCP|IPV4|24|TCP|IPV4|25|TCP|IPV4|26|TCP|IPV4|27|TCP|IPV4|28|TCP|IPV4|29|TCP|IPV4|30|TCP|IPV4|31|TCP|IPV4|32|TCP|IPV4|33|TCP|IPV4|34|TCP|IPV4|35|TCP|IPV4|36|TCP|IPV4|37|TCP|IPV4|38|TCP|IPV4|39|TCP|IPV4|40|TCP|IPV4|41|TCP|IPV4|42|TCP|IPV4|43|TCP|IPV4|44|TCP|IPV4|45|TCP|IPV4|46|TCP|IPV4|47|TCP|IPV4|48|TCP|IPV4|49|TCP|IPV4|50|TCP|IPV4|51|TCP|IPV4|52|TCP|IPV4|53|TCP|IPV4|54|TCP|IPV4|55|TCP|IPV4|56|TCP|IPV4|57|TCP|IPV4|58|TCP|IPV4|59|TCP|IPV4|60|TCP|IPV4|61|TCP|IPV4|62|TCP|IPV4|63|TCP|IPV4|64
